title: Tight Security for Multi-Round Reflection Ciphers
summary: The source covers the two-round case, while extending tight-security guarantees to more rounds under suitable key schedules remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: The unresolved extension beyond the two-round case is to identify sufficient conditions on the key schedule such that, for $r>1$, a $2r$-round key-alternating reflection cipher achieves tight security.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptography, focusing on the security of key-alternating reflection block ciphers.
parameters: r, the round parameter determining the $2r$-round construction
scope.unresolved_remainder: Identify sufficient conditions on the key schedule under which the $2r$-round key-alternating reflection cipher achieves tight security for $r>1$.

progress.summary: The paper presents this in its Future work discussion as a third open problem: generalizing results beyond the two-round case. It asks for sufficient key-schedule conditions yielding tight security for the multi-round construction.
citation_labels: Tim Beyne et al., Provably Secure Reflection Ciphers
